d:
Born into high society, Chae Min-seo is the ultimate elite beauty at the prestigious University of Finance flawlessly attractive, top of her class, and unapologetically dominant. But behind her mesmerizing allure lies a dark past: a once bullied wallflower who transformed her body to turn beauty into an unstoppable weapon. Indulging in a world of power, obsession, and shared intimacy among the ultra-wealthy, Min-seo spins a web of control over powerful men from prominent professors and top idols to her two most devoted heir best friends proving that in the realm of the elite, desire is the highest form of dynamic control.
